author: Priya Iyer
text: Test of Time D2 sentiment looking strong on r/civ — top thread says 'finally the Civ VII I wanted at launch'. Steam reviews trending 87% over last 48h. @comms can we pull a sentiment slide for tomorrow's exec roll-up?

author: Maya Reyes
text: Heads up team, PotatoMcWhiskey's schedule shifted — we can lock the 4-player Time-Tested Civs multiplayer premiere (Potato + ursagaming + Boesthius + Quill18, Fractal Continent showcase) for May 28 instead of May 30. Need confirmation on whether we move the Triumphs system deep-dive solo VoDs with them or split into two days. @alex

author: Tomás Vega
text: Mad Ellie SP1 D30 cohort coming in at 9.8% — under our 14% gate. Recommend we hold the Phase 2 paid surge until we see Patch 1.2 land and re-measure. Drafting brief for Davide — if cohort clears we can re-enter against the Whispering Glacier endgame content beat window.

author: Sarah Wu
text: Crash repro on the encounter transition into the second arena. Reliable, can't ship June 5. Realistic new date is July 10. Looping in @marcus and @alex on comms framing.

author: Daniel Okafor
text: Three refresh creative concepts in QA. Brand review Thursday. Realistically GO/NO-GO June 1 — three days QA, two days traffic split. Sharing the concept boards in this thread shortly.

author: Alex Akiyama
text: Daily standup landed. Two things flagged up to Davide this week: (1) Mad Ellie SP1 Phase 2 surge — recommending hold pending Patch 1.2 + Whispering Glacier endgame content beat window timing, Heaven pre-warned, awaiting Davide call; (2) Wonderlands DLC re-announce — Marcus drafting for Davide sign-off EOD Friday. Everything else operational.

author: Daniel Okafor
text: Heaven Mad Ellie SP1 weekly: Phase 1 paid landed clean on TikTok (Switch 2 C4SH the Rogue reveal cuts pulling well in the broader social mix), Spark Ads boost on top 5 hooks at 22% above benchmark CTR. CPMStar in-game pacing fine. Phase 2 we are paused on per Tomás's note re D30. Will refresh the brief once the gate clears — re-entry against the Whispering Glacier endgame content beat window.

author: Marcus Lee
text: Lurkit Test of Time quest update: 8,200 hours watched D1–D3, 142 streamers participated across Steam + Epic. Cost-per-hour-watched landing at $0.18, well under our $0.25 ceiling. Extending the quest through the weekend to ride the Time-Tested Civs multiplayer premiere halo (Thu May 28) and the Triumphs deep-dive premieres (Sat May 30).

author: Marcus Lee
text: Free Weekend prep: CreatorIQ shortlist of 40 micro/nano FPS-co-op-adjacent creators landing Friday. Lurkit brief drafted, sending Wednesday. Looking at CPM on the awareness layer — CPMStar quote came back at $4.20 estimated.

author: Priya Iyer
text: Brand creative final hero cut for Test of Time NA paid social is in QA now — I have it. Tracking to land in Open World's hands by 4pm today. Sorry for the slip. Audit on the workflow is owed.

author: Marcus Lee
text: Test of Time Discord AMA recap is up — 1,400 live, zero major flashpoints. The pre-emptive Commerce screen + Advisor Council FAQ did its job, the bad-faith threads never formed. r/civ top thread still the 'finally the Civ VII I wanted' one. Closing the loop with a community sentiment one-pager for the exec roll-up.

author: Priya Nadella
text: Mad Ellie SP1 advocacy pool warm — 1,200 BL4 creators tagged from the Mercenary Day cohort, 340 confirmed for the Whispering Glacier endgame beat once Phase 2 clears. Holding the seeding brief until Tomás's D30 call lands so we don't fire creator codes against a paused paid layer.

author: Marcus Lee
text: Glutton's Gamble Encore date slip: 65K standalone wishlisters get a Steam notification when we move the date, so the comms framing matters. Drafting the re-announce now — leading with the why (stability over a rushed drop) and a concrete July 10 target. Need Davide sign-off before it goes out EOD Friday.

author: Dana Whitfield
text: XCOM 30th Anniversary bundle on track for the Sept 8 Steam page refresh. Commemorative trailer in edit, Discord AMA slot held. Catalog-mode cadence so nothing urgent — flagging early just so it's on the radar before the autumn sale window.

author: Dana Whitfield
text: Pre-reveal narrative SEO sweep at 52% share vs 60% target — still climbing but the fan-wiki lore pages are outranking us on a few key terms. Comms drafting a content plan to close the gap before the reveal window. No external assets live yet, all under embargo.

author: Marcus Lee
text: Homeworld 3 Anniversary Content Update creator seeding kicking off — RTS/strategy micro-creators shortlisted, keys going out for the June 28 update. D30 holding 19.4% vs 18% target so sustain is healthy. Low-lift beat, running on the evergreen cadence.
